implementation: legalize_repair_axis accepts an optional deterministic choice path. At each encountered negative cycle, enumerate unique eligible flippable separations in existing cycle-edge order, report their count and execute exactly the selected flip. Missing path entries choose index zero, preserving the existing greedy behaviour. Invalid executed choices throw; no silent substitution. No extra solve or automatic alternative attempt is introduced.

new_coverage: two distinct eligible branches each solve their axis
one flip only and retained constraints
directional gap swap and flip lock

integration_scope: Existing composer calls retain the empty/default path. Historical primitive decisions, current board requirements and independent actual operation counts pass unchanged. No alternative branch is automatically used in board construction yet.
next_step: Integrate a bounded saved-state coupled-axis search which uses the reported choice counts to reconsider earlier greedy decisions, retains the ordinary successful path and records every actual retry/failure. Require final physical and hard-term validation.
limitations: Foundation for backtracking, not an implemented whole-board improvement.
Unused choice-path suffixes are not executed; this supports planned prefixes whose later decisions may not be reached.
Existing per-axis budget semantics are retained; no claim of exhaustive search.
No new accepted board, full qualification or performance improvement claimed.
